svg.title: From a constant to the best linear approximation
svg.desc: Graph of sqrt(x), y=3, the tangent y=3+(x−9)/6, and a trial line with A=3 and B=0.30. The point (9,3) is marked.
svg.metadata: Curves generated with GeoGebra Classic JavaScript API; see scripts/generate-landau-figures.cjs.

g.text: From a constant to a linear approximation
Trial line: A = 3, B = 0.30. Here h = x − 9; all three approximations pass through (9, 3).
